name: meldrix-ai
description: All-in-one AI assistant for VS Code — Claude, Gemini & Grok with GitHub editing, image/video generation, TTS and agentic tools.

meldrix.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Meldrix backend API base URL (without trailing slash).

meldrix.deviceEndpoint.markdownDescription: Device Authorization Flow step 1 (`createDeviceAuthorization`): returns `{ deviceCode, userCode, verificationUri?, expiresIn?, interval? }`.

meldrix.deviceTokenEndpoint.markdownDescription: Device Authorization Flow step 2 (`issueCliSession`): POST `{ deviceCode }`. Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken?, expiresAt? }` on success, or `{ error: 'authorization_pending' | 'slow_down' | 'expired_token' | 'access_denied' }`.

meldrix.refreshEndpoint.markdownDescription: Token refresh endpoint (`refreshCliSession`): POST `{ refreshToken }` -> `{ accessToken, refreshToken?, expiresAt? }`. Called automatically when the access token is expired.

meldrix.verificationUri.markdownDescription: URL opened in the browser for the user to sign in (Gmail) and enter the code.

meldrix.planEndpoint.markdownDescription: Path for the subscription/plan endpoint. This is the route that calls `getAuthenticatedDbUser` + `getSubscriptionByEmail` and returns `{ subscription: { status, plan, endDate, renewsAt, ...row.data } }`.

meldrix.modelsEndpoint.markdownDescription: Optional endpoint returning the models allowed for the caller's tier (uses `MODEL_TIER_REQUIREMENTS` + `isModelAllowedForTier`). Used when the subscription payload has no explicit model list.

meldrix.chatEndpoint.markdownDescription: Path for the streaming chat endpoint (`streamText().toUIMessageStreamResponse()`). Body: `{ messages, id?, modelId, enableSearch?, githubToken?, githubContext?, fileContext? }`.

meldrix.authToken.markdownDescription: Optional static auth token (testing only). Prefer device sign-in which stores the CLI session securely.

meldrix.model.markdownDescription: Default model id sent as `modelId` to the chat route. Leave empty to use the model selected in the UI dropdown (which is populated from your plan).
